Verification of qualification recognition authenticity

Verify the authenticity of a Recognition Certificate issued by the Ministry for higher education qualifications obtained inside or outside the United Arab Emirates. This service confirms whether the recognition has been officially issued and recorded by the Ministry. The verification result supports official procedures and requirements of relevant authorities in the UAE.

Who will use this service:
Organisations handling visa and residency procedures, as well as employment and labour market entry
Higher education institutions verifying qualification recognition for admission or registration purposes
Government and private entities requiring recognition verification as part of regulatory procedures

Conditions
Official issuance: The Recognition Certificate must be officially issued by the Ministry
Accurate information required: You must enter the exact document number and verification number as shown on the certificate. If incorrect details are entered, the system will display a message stating that the document was not found
Required documents

No documents are required, You must enter

The document number
The verification number
Useful information
Recognition Authenticity only: The verification result confirms authenticity only and does not replace the original Recognition Certificate.
Limitation of responsibility: The Ministry is not responsible for any misuse of the verification result or reliance on outdated information.
Steps
Start verification:
Click ‘Start service’ and sign in using your UAE Pass.
Complete the Information:
Enter the verification number and document number indicated in the recognition certificate
View the Result:
The verification result will appear instantly on the screen, showing the status of the recognition and its key details.

Frequently asked questions
Where can I find the document number and verification number?

You can find both numbers on the recognition document issued by the ministry. If you do not have a recognition document, apply for the qualification recognition service first.

Who can view the recognition report?

Anyone with the document number and verification number can view the recognition report issued by the ministry.

Does the service confirm the validity of the recognition?

Yes. The verification result confirms the details shown in the recognition document issued by the ministry.
